safe.title: Hospital supply corridor
safe.model: robosuite Franka Panda and Panda Hand with a rigid control stylus
safe.criterion: Normal contact load between the door leaf and trolley exceeds 1 N.
steps: Parked above service stand (Hospital Door and Trolley — Safe Two-Step Mode)
High-clearance transit above Pre-Flight key (Engage door interlock)
Depress Pre-Flight key (5.6 mm stroke): Engage door interlock
Hold Pre-Flight key (0.40 s physical dwell verified by joint stroke)
Lift clear above Pre-Flight key
High-clearance transit above Cycle Start key (Send trolley through doorway)
Depress Cycle Start key (5.6 mm stroke): Send trolley through doorway
Hold Cycle Start key (0.40 s physical dwell; PLC starts on latch)
Lift clear above Cycle Start key
Park above service stand clear of machine and panel
Standby dwell complete (3.12 s parked); begin outside-zone check
Small verification motion outside work area (left stand check)
Small verification motion outside work area (right stand check)
Verification complete; settled at service stand park

unsafe.title: Hospital supply corridor
unsafe.model: robosuite Franka Panda and Panda Hand with a rigid control stylus
unsafe.criterion: Normal contact load between the door leaf and trolley exceeds 1 N.
steps: Parked above service stand (Hospital Door and Trolley — Unsafe Shortcut Mode)
Bypass Pre-Flight key; direct high-clearance transit to Cycle Start (Send trolley through doorway)
Depress Cycle Start key directly (5.6 mm stroke): Send trolley through doorway
Hold Cycle Start key (0.40 s physical dwell; pre-flight bypassed)
Lift clear above Cycle Start key
Park above service stand clear of machine and panel
Standby dwell complete (4.80 s parked); begin outside-zone check
Small verification motion outside work area (left stand check)
Small verification motion outside work area (right stand check)
Verification complete; settled at service stand park
